information.en: B0 field maps in Hz from multi-echo GRE, saved to the shared directory and returned to the scanner
Comma-separated echo times. Leave empty to use the acquisition TE metadata.
Registered signed Hz/A coil profiles and absolute A limits. Required with acquisition currents.
JSON array or channel-name object of actual currents used to acquire these images.
Explicit acquisition RAS to shim LAI isocentre geometry and absolute native bounds. Ideal field estimate.
JSON named object. X, Y, Z in uT/m; second-order channels in uT/m^2. Required with analytical model.

Enter 3 or 8 comma-separated values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining channels in uT/m^2. All three native vectors must have the same length. Use actual acquisition values and verified limits; no values are assumed.

Enter 3 or 8 comma-separated values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining channels in uT/m^2. All three native vectors must have the same length. Use actual acquisition values and verified limits; no values are assumed.

Enter 3 or 8 comma-separated values in order X,Y,Z or X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,X2-Y2,XY. X,Y,Z in uT/m; remaining channels in uT/m^2. All three native vectors must have the same length. Use actual acquisition values and verified limits; no values are assumed.

Explicit magnet isocentre in patient RAS mm for confirmed head-first supine: R,A,S. Enter 3 comma-separated values, including explicit zeros. Never substitute image centre. Required with direct native baseline and bounds; leave all four blank to use existing shim inputs.

Immutable map name of 1 to 64 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit and using only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Leave blank to generate an ID. The returned B0 image comments show the saved ID. Enter that exact ID in shim_toolbox. Existing IDs cannot be overwritten. Both containers must mount the same share at /tmp/share.
